data.body: SW-headroom found no company-floor mechanism for [swarm]: headroom_floor_usd can be raised by a project or user layer but a lower layer can also lower it, and [prices] layering replaces the whole table. Add a company-layer floor (strictest-wins for headroom_floor_usd, limits that cannot be raised above the company value). SW-headroom meets 'cannot be loosened' at the call-site level only (effective_floor).
data.title: Company floor for swarm headroom: a company layer's headroom floor and [prices] limits that a project or user layer cannot loosen
